summary: The agent failed because it claimed success without running the actual test suite (exit code 4 from verify_before_submit.py). The test file test_output.py existed but wasn't found by the search. Additionally, the INDEX/MATCH formula used incorrect header row references (Data!$H$21:$L$21 instead of the correct header row). This update strengthens the blocking condition for missing tests, adds troubleshooting for formula reference mismatches, and expands test discovery locations.
